# How much should you commit to?

> Free AWS Savings Plan and Reserved Instance calculator. Paste your hourly or daily usage and each option's discount to find the commitment that saves the most, its break-even utilization, upfront payback and what happens if usage falls. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
